function GameHelper:TryRemoveObstaclesAround(rootModel:Model)
    task.delay(1,function()
        if not rootModel or not rootModel:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

        -- 移除周边的装饰物
        local tags = {
            GameEnum.Tag.DecorativeStones,
            GameEnum.Tag.Tree,
            GameEnum.Tag.BigTree,
        }
        
        local cframe,size = rootModel:GetBoundingBox()
        local op = OverlapParams.new()
        for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
            op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(tag))
        end
        op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe,size,op)
        for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
            for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
                local model:BasePart = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,tag)
                if model then
                    model:RemoveTag(tag)
                    model:Destroy()
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

function GameHelper:DestroyAndSmashTarget(target:Instance,lifeTime:number?,force:number?)
    if not target then return end
    if not lifeTime then lifeTime = 0 end
    if not force then force = 20 end

    Debris:AddItem(target,lifeTime + 2)
    -- 粉碎
    if lifeTime > 0 then
        -- 清理所有Tag
        local tags = target:GetTags()
        for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
            target:RemoveTag(tag)
        end

        -- 粉碎掉
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(math.min(lifeTime * 0.5,1),Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)
        for _,child:Instance in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                local basePart:BasePart = child
                if basePart.Transparency == 1 then continue end
                basePart.Anchored = false
                basePart.CanCollide = true
                basePart.CanQuery = false
                basePart.CanTouch = false
                basePart.Massless = true
                basePart.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment
                local randomVec3 = CommonFunc:RandomVector3(force)
                basePart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(randomVec3.X,force,randomVec3.Z)
                -- basePart:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(Vector3.yAxis * 50,basePart.Position)
                TweenService:Create(basePart,tweenInfo,{
                    Transparency = 1
                }):Play()
            elseif child:IsA("Script") or child:IsA("WeldConstraint") or child:IsA("JointInstance") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end

        -- 延迟置空
        task.delay(lifeTime,function()
            target.Parent = nil
        end)
    else
        target.Parent = nil
    end
end

function ToolHelper:Pinkup(player:Player,newTool:Tool)

    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.dragItem,nil)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(newTool,DragItemValue.dragPlayer,nil)
    if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(newTool) then
        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(newTool)
        if resLo.lv then
            -- 移除同款工具
            local oldTool = ToolHelper:GetToolByType(player,resLo.ItemType)
            if oldTool then
                -- oldTool.Parent = nil
                -- ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(oldTool,1)
                if player.Character and oldTool.CanBeDropped then
                    if oldTool.Parent == player.Character then
                        ToolHelper:DropTool(player)
                    else
                        local cframe = player.Character:GetPivot()
                        oldTool.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
                        oldTool.Parent = workspace
                        task.delay(0.1,function()
                            oldTool:PivotTo(cframe)
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    oldTool.Parent = nil
                    ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(oldTool,1)
                end

            end
        end

        if not newTool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EquipedSkinResItem) then
            local skinId = DataHelper:GetInUseSkin(player,CommonEnum.SkinType.ResItem,resLo.id)
            -- print(resLo.id)
            -- if resLo.id == 103 then
            --     skinId = 6
            -- end
            if skinId then
                local skinLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetSkinLo(skinId)
                if skinLo then
                    local prefab = ResourcesItemHelper:FindSkinPrefabByName(skinLo.prefabName)
                    if prefab then
                        local cframe = newTool:GetPivot()
                        ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(newTool)
                        newTool = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(resLo.id,cframe,nil,prefab)
                        newTool:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EquipedSkinResItem)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        GameAnalytics:LogPinkupTool(player,resLo.id)
    end

    ToolHelper:Store(player,newTool)
end

function ToolHelper:EquipTool(player:Player,tool:Tool)
    if not tool then return end
    if RunService:IsClient() then
        ToolHelper.EquipToolC2S:FireServer(tool)
    else
        ToolHelper:UnequipTools(player)
        if tool.PrimaryPart then
            tool.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
        end
        tool:PivotTo(player.Character:GetPivot())
        tool.Parent = player.Character
    end
end

function ToolHelper:UnequipTools(player:Player)
    if RunService:IsClient() then
        ToolHelper.UnequipToolsC2S:FireServer()
    else
        local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
        if not tool then return end

        ToolHelper:Store(player,tool)
    end
end

    local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
    if tool then
        tool.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
        tool.Parent = workspace
    end
end

    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    local ret:{Tool} = {}
    local handTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
    if handTool then
        local toolId = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(handTool,DragItemValue.id)
        if toolId == id then
            table.insert(ret,handTool)
        end
    end

    local backpack = ToolHelper:GetBackpack(player)
    for _,tool:Tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if not tool:IsA("Tool") then continue end
        local toolId = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(tool,DragItemValue.id)
        if toolId == id then
            table.insert(ret,tool)
        end
    end

    return ret

    end

function ResourcesItemHelper:InitItem(id:number,item:Model,owner:Player?)
    local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
    item.Name = lo.ItemName
    for _,child:BasePart in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") then
            child.Anchored = false
        end
    end

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(item,DragItemValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(item,DragItemValue.id,id)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(item,DragItemValue.itemType,lo.ItemType)

    if lo.CanStore then
        item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.CanStore)
    end
    item:AddTag(lo.ItemType)
    item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ResourcesItem)
    item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
    item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)
    if item:IsA("Tool") then
        item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tool)
    end

    local valueMode = ValueHelper.ValueModel:FindFirstChild(string.format("%sValue",lo.ItemType))
    if valueMode then
        ValueHelper:InitByModel(item,valueMode)
    end
    -- if lo.ItemType == GameEnum.Tag.Gun then
    --     ValueHelper:InitByModel(item,GunValue)
    -- end

    if owner then
        ValueHelper:SetValue(item,DragItemValue.owner,owner)
    end

    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(item,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.ResourcesItem)
end

function ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(id:number,cframe:CFrame?,owner:Player?,skinPrefab:Instance?)
    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
    if not resLo then
        error(string.format("创建物品失败，无效物品的id:%d",id))
    end
    if resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.Tag.BluePrint and resLo.param then
        local craftItem = CraftItemHelper:CreateItem(tonumber(resLo.param))
        if cframe then
            craftItem:PivotTo(cframe)
        end
        return craftItem
    end

    local prefab = skinPrefab or ResourcesItemHelper:GetPrefab(id)
    if not prefab then return end

    local item:Model = prefab:Clone()
    item.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
    if item:IsA("Tool") and not item.PrimaryPart then
        item.PrimaryPart = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    end
    ResourcesItemHelper:InitItem(id,item,owner)
    if cframe then
        item:PivotTo(cframe)
    end
    item.Parent = workspace

    return item
end

function ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item:Model,lifeTime:number?)
    item = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(item,GameEnum.Tag.ResourcesItem)
    if not ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(item) then return end

    local player:Player = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(item,DragItemValue.dragPlayer)
    if player then
        ValueHelper:SetValue(item,DragItemValue.dragPlayer,nil)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.dragItem,nil)
    end

    local tags = item:GetTags()
    for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
        item:RemoveTag(tag)
    end
    -- item.Parent = nil
    if not lifeTime then lifeTime = 0 end
    task.delay(lifeTime,function()
        item.Parent = nil
    end)
    Debris:AddItem(item,1 + lifeTime)
end

function AudioConfig:Validate(effectFolder)
    local missing = {}
    local extras = {}
    local seen = {}

    for name in pairs(self.Effects) do
        local sound = effectFolder and effectFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not sound or not sound:IsA("Sound") then
            table.insert(missing, name)
        else
            seen[name] = true
        end
    end

    if effectFolder then
        for _, child in ipairs(effectFolder:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("Sound") and not self.Effects[child.Name] then
                table.insert(extras, child.Name)
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(missing)
    table.sort(extras)
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(self.Effects) do
        count += 1
    end
    return {
        Missing = missing,
        Extras = extras,
        Count = count,
    }
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))

local HitReactionHelper = {}

local EFFECT_NAMES = {
    [1] = "Punch-01",
    [2] = "Punch-02",
    [3] = "Punch-03",
}

local MAX_PER_VARIANT = 4
local MAX_ACTIVE = 12
local LIFETIME = 0.55
local TARGET_INTERVAL = 0.08
local random = Random.new()

local skippedSources = {}
for _, sourceName in ipairs({
    "Poisoned",
    "Burning",
    "Trap",
    "Light",
    "HolyWater",
    "HolySword",
    "Explosion",
}) do
    local source = GameEnum.DamageSource and GameEnum.DamageSource[sourceName]
    if source ~= nil then
        skippedSources[source] = true
    end
end

local lastVariantByTarget = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function isFiniteNumber(value)
    return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

function HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(value)
    return typeof(value) == "Vector3"
        and isFiniteNumber(value.X)
        and isFiniteNumber(value.Y)
        and isFiniteNumber(value.Z)
end

function HitReactionHelper.ShouldPlay(attacker, target, damage, damageSource, context)
    if not attacker or not target then
        return false
    end
    if typeof(damage) ~= "number" or damage <= 0 or damage ~= damage then
        return false
    end
    if context and context.SuppressHitReaction == true then
        return false
    end
    local source = damageSource or (context and context.DamageSource)
    if source ~= nil and skippedSources[source] then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function getTargetPosition(target)
    if not target then
        return nil
    end
    for _, name in ipairs({"UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart"}) do
        local part = target:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            return part.Position
        end
    end
    local primary = target.PrimaryPart
    if primary and primary:IsA("BasePart") then
        return primary.Position
    end
    local ok, pivot = pcall(target.GetPivot, target)
    if ok and pivot then
        return pivot.Position
    end
    return nil
end

function HitReactionHelper.ResolvePosition(target, context)
    local requested = context and context.HitPosition
    if HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(requested) and target then
        local ok, boxCFrame, boxSize = pcall(target.GetBoundingBox, target)
        if ok and boxCFrame and boxSize then
            local localPosition = boxCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(requested)
            local limit = boxSize * 0.5 + Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
            if math.abs(localPosition.X) <= limit.X
                and math.abs(localPosition.Y) <= limit.Y
                and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= limit.Z then
                return requested
            end
        end
    end

    return getTargetPosition(target) or requested
end

function HitReactionHelper.ResolveDirection(attacker, target, context, hitPosition)
    local requested = context and context.HitDirection
    if HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(requested) and requested.Magnitude > 0.001 then
        return requested.Unit
    end

    local attackerPosition
    if attacker and attacker:IsA("Model") then
        attackerPosition = getTargetPosition(attacker)
    elseif attacker and attacker:IsA("BasePart") then
        attackerPosition = attacker.Position
    end
    local targetPosition = hitPosition or getTargetPosition(target)
    if attackerPosition and targetPosition then
        local direction = targetPosition - attackerPosition
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            return direction.Unit
        end
    end
    return Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
end

function HitReactionHelper.ChooseVariant(target, critical)
    if critical then
        lastVariantByTarget[target] = 3
        return 3
    end

    local last = lastVariantByTarget[target]
    local variant = random:NextInteger(1, 3)
    if last and variant == last then
        variant = variant % 3 + 1
    end
    lastVariantByTarget[target] = variant
    return variant
end

function HitReactionHelper.GetTargetInterval()
    return TARGET_INTERVAL
end

function HitReactionHelper.IsEnabled()
    local gameplaySwitches = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("玩法开关")
    local toggle = gameplaySwitches and gameplaySwitches:FindFirstChild("EnablePunchHitReaction")
    return not toggle or toggle.Value ~= false
end

local clientReady = false
local clientStartPending = false
local retryScheduled = false
local pendingBatches = {}
local prefabs
local pools = {
    [1] = {available = {}, created = 0},
    [2] = {available = {}, created = 0},
    [3] = {available = {}, created = 0},
}
local activeRecords = {}
local activeCount = 0
local clientLastByTarget = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function getEffectFolder()
    local prefabsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")
    return prefabsFolder and prefabsFolder:FindFirstChild("Effects")
end

local function disableAndHide(instance)
    local function normalizePart(part)
        part.Transparency = 1
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.CanTouch = false
        part.CanQuery = false
        part.CastShadow = false
    end

    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        normalizePart(instance)
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            normalizePart(descendant)
        elseif descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            descendant.Enabled = false
            descendant.Rate = 0
        end
    end
end

local function makeInstance(variant)
    local template = prefabs and prefabs[variant]
    if not template then
        return nil
    end
    local instance = template:Clone()
    disableAndHide(instance)
    return instance
end

local function release(instance, variant)
    local record = activeRecords[instance]
    if not record then
        return
    end
    activeRecords[instance] = nil
    activeCount = math.max(activeCount - 1, 0)
    if instance and instance.Parent then
        instance.Parent = nil
    end
    if instance and instance.Parent == nil then
        local pool = pools[variant]
        if pool and instance.Parent == nil then
            table.insert(pool.available, instance)
        elseif instance then
            instance:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function acquire(variant)
    if activeCount >= MAX_ACTIVE then
        return nil
    end
    local pool = pools[variant]
    if not pool then
        return nil
    end

    local instance = table.remove(pool.available)
    if not instance then
        if pool.created >= MAX_PER_VARIANT then
            return nil
        end
        instance = makeInstance(variant)
        if not instance then
            return nil
        end
        pool.created += 1
    end

    activeCount += 1
    activeRecords[instance] = {variant = variant}
    return instance
end

function HitReactionHelper.InitializeClient()
    if clientReady or clientStartPending then
        return
    end
    clientStartPending = true

    local effects = getEffectFolder()
    if not effects then
        clientStartPending = false
        if not retryScheduled then
            retryScheduled = true
            task.delay(0.25, function()
                retryScheduled = false
                if not clientReady then
                    HitReactionHelper.InitializeClient()
                end
            end)
        end
        return
    end

    prefabs = {
        [1] = effects:FindFirstChild(EFFECT_NAMES[1]),
        [2] = effects:FindFirstChild(EFFECT_NAMES[2]),
        [3] = effects:FindFirstChild(EFFECT_NAMES[3]),
    }

    local preloadList = {}
    for variant = 1, 3 do
        if prefabs[variant] then
            table.insert(preloadList, prefabs[variant])
        else
            warn("[HitReaction] Missing effect prefab: " .. EFFECT_NAMES[variant])
        end
    end

    clientReady = true
    clientStartPending = false
    local queued = pendingBatches
    pendingBatches = {}
    for _, batch in ipairs(queued) do
        HitReactionHelper.PlayBatch(batch)
    end

    if #preloadList > 0 then
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(preloadList)
            end)
        end)
    end
end

function HitReactionHelper.PlayBatch(packets)
    if typeof(packets) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    if not HitReactionHelper.IsEnabled() then
        return
    end
    if not clientReady then
        HitReactionHelper.InitializeClient()
        if not clientReady then
            if #pendingBatches < 8 then
                table.insert(pendingBatches, packets)
            end
            return
        end
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    for _, packet in ipairs(packets) do
        if typeof(packet) ~= "table" then
            continue
        end
        local position = packet.Position
        local direction = packet.Direction
        local variant = packet.Variant
        if not HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
            continue
        end
        if not HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(direction) or direction.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
            direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
        else
            direction = direction.Unit
        end
        if typeof(variant) ~= "number" or variant < 1 or variant > 3 then
            continue
        end

        local target = packet.Target
        local critical = packet.Critical == true
        if target then
            local last = clientLastByTarget[target]
            if last and now - last < TARGET_INTERVAL and not critical then
                continue
            end
            clientLastByTarget[target] = now
        end

        local instance = acquire(math.floor(variant))
        if not instance then
            continue
        end

        local frame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
            instance.CFrame = frame
        else
            instance:PivotTo(frame)
        end
        instance.Parent = workspace

        local emitter = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ParticleEmitter", true)
        if emitter then
            emitter.Enabled = false
            emitter:Emit(1)
        end

        local usedVariant = math.floor(variant)
        task.delay(LIFETIME, function()
            release(instance, usedVariant)
        end)
    end
end

function HitReactionHelper.GetDebugStats()
    local created = {}
    local available = {}
    for variant = 1, 3 do
        created[variant] = pools[variant].created
        available[variant] = #pools[variant].available
    end
    return {
        Active = activeCount,
        MaxActive = MAX_ACTIVE,
        Created = created,
        Available = available,
        Ready = clientReady,
        Pending = #pendingBatches,
    }
end

return HitReactionHelper

    return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function isValidEnemy(enemy: Model, character: Model): boolean
    if not enemy or enemy == character or not enemy:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
    if not GameHelper:IsNPC(enemy) or enemy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath) then return false end
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return getRoot(enemy) ~= nil
end

local function findNearestEnemy(character: Model, root: BasePart, radius: number): Model?
    local params = OverlapParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    params.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    params.MaxParts = 128

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.AutoFace.Query")
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, math.min(radius, 12), params)
    debug.profileend()

    local nearest
    local nearestDistance = math.min(radius, 12) ^ 2
    local seen = {}
    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
        if model and not seen[model] and isValidEnemy(model, character) then
            seen[model] = true
            local enemyRoot = getRoot(model)
            local delta = enemyRoot.Position - root.Position
            local distance = delta:Dot(delta)
            if distance <= nearestDistance then
                nearestDistance = distance
                nearest = model
            end
        end
    end
    return nearest
end

local function faceTarget(character: Model, target: Model, duration: number)
    task.spawn(function()
        local endAt = os.clock() + duration
        while os.clock() < endAt and character == LocalPlayer.Character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
            local root = getRoot(character)
            local targetRoot = getRoot(target)
            if not root or not targetRoot or not isValidEnemy(target, character) then return end
            local rootPos = root.Position
            local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
            local flatTarget = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, rootPos.Y, targetPos.Z)
            if (flatTarget - rootPos).Magnitude > 0.1 then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, flatTarget)
            end
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

local function scheduleCooldownRestore(tool: Tool, state)
    local remaining = math.max(0, state.endsAt - workspace.DistributedGameTime)
    task.delay(remaining, function()
        if toolCooldowns[tool] ~= state then return end

        local timeLeft = state.endsAt - workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if timeLeft > 0 then
            scheduleCooldownRestore(tool, state)
            return
        end

        -- The tool may be temporarily unparented while another system moves it.
        -- Keep the expired record in that case so the next equip can restore it.
        if tool.Parent then
            toolCooldowns[tool] = nil
            tool.Enabled = true
        end
    end)
end

function MeleeCombatClient.TryBeginCooldown(tool: Tool, duration: number): boolean
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end

    local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
    local current = toolCooldowns[tool]
    if current and timeNow < current.endsAt then
        tool.Enabled = false
        return false
    end

    local state = {
        endsAt = timeNow + math.max(0, tonumber(duration) or 0),
    }
    toolCooldowns[tool] = state
    tool.Enabled = false
    scheduleCooldownRestore(tool, state)
    return true
end

function MeleeCombatClient.RefreshCooldown(tool: Tool): boolean
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end

    local state = toolCooldowns[tool]
    if not state then
        return false
    end
    if workspace.DistributedGameTime >= state.endsAt then
        toolCooldowns[tool] = nil
        tool.Enabled = true
        return false
    end

    tool.Enabled = false
    return true
end

function MeleeCombatClient.GetProfile(tool: Tool)
    local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    local id = lo and tonumber(lo.id)
    return id and MeleeWeaponSetting.GetById(id), lo
end

function MeleeCombatClient.BeginSwing(tool: Tool, character: Model)
    if not tool or not character or character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local profile = MeleeCombatClient.GetProfile(tool)
    if not profile then return nil end

    swingCounter += 1
    local swingId = swingCounter
    pending[swingId] = tool

    if autoFaceSwitch.Value then
        local root = getRoot(character)
        if root then
            local target = findNearestEnemy(character, root, profile.reach + profile.autoFaceExtraRange)
            if target then
                faceTarget(character, target, profile.autoFaceDuration)
            end
        end
    end

    task.delay(profile.windup, function()
        if pending[swingId] == tool and tool.Parent == character and character == LocalPlayer.Character then
            MeleeAttackC2S:FireServer(swingId)
        end
    end)
    task.delay(profile.cooldown + profile.autoFaceDuration + 1, function()
        if pending[swingId] == tool then
            pending[swingId] = nil
        end
    end)
    return swingId, profile
end

MeleeHitS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(swingId: number, hitCount: number)
    local tool = pending[swingId]
    if not tool or not tool:IsDescendantOf(game) then return end
    if hitCount and hitCount > 0 then
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1, #hitSounds)], tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"), {
            SourceUserId = LocalPlayer.UserId,
            SourceKey = "melee-hit:" .. tool.Name,
        })
    end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    for tool in pairs(toolCooldowns) do
        if tool.Parent then
            tool.Enabled = true
        end
    end
    table.clear(toolCooldowns)
    table.clear(pending)
end)
